opening.argument: The presentation gives concrete instructions for joining a tiered commission structure: viewers are directed to the Forsage BUSD site and told that a 10 BUSD investment is divided between X3 and X4. The speaker then ties payments to downline, upline, and cross-line positions, claims prospective X3 earnings of $39,700, and links a slot purchase to repeated income. These are not merely descriptions of account statistics: the speaker also invites viewers interested in the plan to make contact. The review framing and invitation to examine whether people are earning do not change the substance of those investment and recruitment instructions or the solicitation they culminate in.
